lm.intro: Import an FFLogs timeline, choose a preset, then enable replay when you are ready.
lm.manual: Replay requires a matching job, a loaded replay preset and a real fight. It never starts automatically from this screen.
lm.empty: No replay presets yet. Import a log to get started.
lm.target_help: Select a target in game, enter its FFLogs actor ID and bind it during an active replay session. Show target IDs prints the recorded targets in chat.
lm.empty_target: Load a replay preset to see its recorded targets.

cmd.help.oracle:
Open LogMimic
/lm config — Settings
/lm replay list — List replay presets
/lm replay load <name> — Load a replay preset
/lm replay on|off|status — Replay controls
/lm overlay timeline|major|icon — Toggle overlays
/lm autorecord — Toggle recording
/lm load <name> — Load a timeline
/lm unload — Unload timeline
/lm preview start [sec]|pause|stop — Preview
/lm debug — Debug window
lm.autoload_help: Load this preset when zone, job and phase match. Only one preset can use each match. An Any phase matches by zone and job. Presets do not switch during combat; enabling replay remains manual. Edit zone, job and phase in the library.
